prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'EchoSystems Chrono Compendium v1.0' (chunk 14.48) about time: Henri Bergson believed that time was neither a real homogeneous medium nor a mental construct, but possesses what he ref
true_answer: Henri Bergson believed that time was neither a real homogeneous medium nor a mental construct, but possesses what he referred to as Duration. Duration, in Bergson's view, was creativity and memory as an essential component of reality.[80] Time is not an empirical concept. For neither co- existence nor succession would be perceived by us, if the representation of time did not exist as a foundation a priori. Without this presupposition, we could not represent to ourselves that things exist together at one and the same time, or at diﬀerent times, that is, contemporaneously, or in succession.
